text.p: Diagnostic Health Services Inc said Wednesday it is calling for the redemption of its 1,375,000 outstanding common stock purchase warrants.
Holders of the warrants may purchase one common share by exercising one warrant at the exercise price of $6.25 per share until 1700 EST/2200 GMT March 21, the company said.
It said warrants which are not exercised will be considered canceled, and will only represent the right to receive, upon surrender of the warrant certificate, the sum of $0.05 per canceled warrant.
Proceeds of up to $8,593,750 from the exercise of such warrants will be used for possible acquisitions, to reduce existing debt and for general corporate purposes.

"It is important to note that because the warrants have been in the money for some time and are considered to be common stock equivalents under treasury method accounting, there will not be significant earnings per share dilution caused by the redemption of these warrants," chief executive Max W. Batzer said. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
